references.notes: Based on MSW generated in 3 counties (Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu) in 2021.

Value calculated based on total MSW generated per year divided by 365 and population of Kenya. The 3 counties, Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, are the largest urban centres in Kenya, of which Nairobi generates 62% of the total waste generated in the country. Hence, MSW generated by tree largest counties and total country population is used to derive national MSW generation rate, as rural MSW generation rate is very low.
